trials.claim: Deal includes all future Personal, Pro, Business, or Enterprise plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Personal (Tier 1), Pro (Tier 2), Business (Tier 3), or Enterprise (Tiers 4-5) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say features and limits depend on the plan purchased and currently released features, and AppSumo buyers get only the included plan updates specified in their offer at purchase, materially limiting the promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: Available features, voices, generation allowances, and website limits depend on the plan purchased and the features currently released.
exhibits.argument: The claim promises all future plan updates, but the terms make features and limits depend on the purchased plan and currently released features.

exhibits.quote: Purchases through AppSumo receive the tier, allowances, lifetime access, and included plan updates specified in the applicable offer at the time of purchase.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime updates are limited to what the specific AppSumo offer stated at purchase, not all future Personal to Enterprise updates.

trials.claim: Player integrates with all HTML websites including WordPress, Joomla, Wix, and Shopify
trials.claimQuote: Integrate the player into your website with support for all HTML websites, including WordPress, Joomla, Wix, and Shopify
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, Joomla, and custom HTML as supported, and a buyer confirms it working in a Shopify store; reports of initial difficulty do not show integration fails.

exhibits.quote: At start a bit tricky to understand. Because I am not a Coder it's new for me to work with code stuff.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports confusion placing code, undermining the claim of easy integration with all HTML websites.

exhibits.quote: When I introduced the HTML code on different types of pages, I encountered some difficulties, but I immediately contacted technical support
exhibits.argument: The buyer encountered difficulties embedding HTML code across pages, contradicting seamless support for all HTML sites.

exhibits.quote: WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, Joomla, or custom HTML. Keep the platform you love. Add a voice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Joomla and custom HTML as supported platforms for the player.

exhibits.quote: team at GSpeech were instrumental in getting GSpeech working in our Shopify store.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the player was made to work in a Shopify store.

trials.claim: Converts text into engaging audio in real time using 230+ voices in 70+ languages
trials.claimQuote: Convert text into engaging audio content in real time using 230+ voices in 70+ languages
trials.reasoning: The vendor states 300+ voices in 98 languages and real-time audio workflows, exceeding the claimed 230+ voices in 70+ languages; stored playback and premium credit costs do not contradict that count.

exhibits.quote: Credits are counted when new audio is generated. Playback of a stored file is not a new character bill (Generate Once, Keep and Play).
exhibits.argument: Audio is generated once then replayed from storage, which undermines the claim of converting text in real time.

exhibits.quote: Credits: 1 credit = 1 character on standard AI voices. Premium voices use more credits per character.
exhibits.argument: Not all voices cost the same, so the advertised 230+ voices are limited by higher credit consumption for premium voices.

exhibits.quote: Unified AI Voice Engine, 300+: Google Cloud, Gemini, and OpenAI in one engine. No API keys. 300+ voices in 98 languages.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states 300+ voices in 98 languages, exceeding the claimed 230+ voices in 70+ languages.

exhibits.quote: 98 AI languages with Real-Time Audio Translation workflows.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms real-time audio translation across 98 AI languages.

trials.claim: Converts site text into lifelike audio for a more engaging user experience
trials.claimQuote: Seamlessly convert your site’s text into lifelike audio content for a more engaging user experience
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes converting site content into high-quality audio for a more engaging experience, and a buyer confirms lifelike text-to-speech audio; a disclaimer and one hard-to-pronounce name do not materially undercut this.

exhibits.quote: Automated speech and translation can contain pronunciation, meaning, or other errors.
exhibits.argument: The vendor warns output can have pronunciation and meaning errors, undermining the claim of lifelike audio.

exhibits.quote: The AI wasn't able to pronounce a business name (I don't blame it, is is a Celtic language word!).
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the AI failed to pronounce a name correctly, contradicting lifelike conversion.

exhibits.quote: Text-to-speech technology can create more engaging content for customers. Convert your articles, blog or any content into high-quality text-to-speech audio for users who prefer listening over reading.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states site articles and content are converted into high-quality audio for a more engaging experience.

exhibits.quote: you can start generating lifelike text-to-speech audio in no time
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool generates lifelike text-to-speech audio easily.

trials.claim: Gives users control to skip, adjust volume, and change playback speed
trials.claimQuote: Give users full control to skip around, adjust volume, and change the playback speed
trials.reasoning: Speed control is only available where the voice family supports it and limited to controls for the selected voice, materially limiting the claim of full user control to change playback speed.

exhibits.quote: Voice Tuning: Adjust speed and pitch where the voice family supports it.
exhibits.argument: Speed adjustment is only available where the voice family supports it, not full control for all users.

exhibits.quote: Fine-tune speaking speed and pitch with the controls available for your selected voice.
exhibits.argument: Speed and pitch controls are limited to what is available for the selected voice, undermining full user control.
